en: O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who bestows eternal bliss, who grants boons and fearlessness, who is a mine of the jewels of beauty, who purifies all by washing away every terrible sin, who is the manifest Maheshvari, who sanctifies the lineage of the Snowy Mountain (Himalaya), and who is the sovereign lady of the city of Kashi—grant me alms, O you who provide the support of compassion! 1.

She who adorns herself with various jewels and diverse ornaments, who is resplendent in golden garments, whose two jar-like breasts are beautiful with hanging pearl necklaces; she who is perfumed with saffron and aloe-wood, who is delightful, the sovereign lady of the city of Kāśī, the Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī who extends the hand of compassion—grant me alms! (2)

Bestower of the bliss of yoga, destroyer of enemies, establisher of righteousness and wealth; possessing waves that shine like the moon, the sun, and fire, protector of the three worlds; grantress of all sovereignty and every desire, sovereign lady of the city of Kāśī, O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who provides refuge through compassion, grant me alms! 3.

O Gaurī, whose abode is the cave of Mount Kailāsa; O Umā, who brings auspiciousness to Śaṅkara; O Kaumārī, who makes the meaning of the Vedas her domain; O you whose seed-syllable is the letter *Oṃ*; O breaker of the door-panels to the city of liberation; O sovereign lady of the city of Kāśī; O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who provides the support of compassion, grant me alms! 4.

O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who makes the visible and invisible manifest as Your vehicle, whose belly contains the vessel of the cosmic egg, who pierces the threads of the drama of worldly play, who is the sprout of the lamp of supreme knowledge, who gladdens the mind of the illustrious Lord of the Universe, and who provides the support of compassion—grant us alms! 5.

The vast one, the sovereign of all people, the Blessed Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, whose mass of hair is like the dark-blue Veṇī, the eternal mistress of the gift of food, the bringer of joy to all, the constant doer of good, the sovereign of the city of Kāśī—O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who provides the support of compassion, grant me alms! (6)

O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who manifests all letters from 'a' to 'kṣa', who brings forth the three states of Śambhu, the Kashmirian Mistress of Tripura, the three-eyed one, the eternal sprout, the night; you who fulfill desires and bring about the arising of beings, the Sovereign of the City of Kāśī, and the one who provides the support of compassion—grant me alms! 7.

O Goddess, fashioned from all manner of diverse jewels, daughter of Dakṣa, beautiful one, auspicious one, who bestows what is dear upon those who maintain the use of sweet things, sovereign of good fortune and Maheśvara; you who grant the desires of devotees, who remove the ten inauspicious states, sovereign of the city of Kāśī, O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who provide the support of compassion, grant me alms! (8)

Resembling millions upon millions of abodes of the moon and sun, surpassing the orb of the moon’s rays, wearing earrings equal to the moon, sun, and fire, the sovereign whose complexion is like the moon and sun; holding a garland, a book, a noose, and a goad, the sovereign lady of the city of Kāśī, the Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī who extends her hand as a support of compassion—grant me alms! 9.

O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, who provides protection to the Kṣatriyas, who grants great fearlessness, who is an ocean of compassion, who is liberation personified, who always bestows auspiciousness, who is the Sovereign of the Universe, the Holder of Fortune, who relieves the cries of the distressed, who bestows freedom from disease, and who is the Mistress of the City of Kāśī—O Mother, who provides the support of mercy, grant me alms! 10.

O Blessed One, Mother of the entire world, protect me—afflicted by the disease of worldly existence arising from my own misdeeds, pursued by the calamities of sons, daughters, and wife, and my mind bewildered; look upon me with Your radiant, nectar-like gaze! Oṃ, salutations to You. (11)

O Annapūrṇā, I, accompanied by my wife and children who are afflicted by hunger, take refuge in you—Bhavānī, the wish-fulfilling creeper of Maheśvara’s consort, who brings about the destruction of the cycle of worldly existence. 12.
O Daughter of the Mountain King, protect me who am being consumed by the forest fire of poverty; immerse me in your ocean of compassion, with my mental faculties offered at your lotus feet. 13.
O Annapūrṇā, who are ever-full, the beloved of Śaṅkara’s very life-breath; O Pārvatī, grant me alms for the sake of attaining knowledge and dispassion. 14.
His mother is the goddess Pārvatī, his father is Lord Maheśvara, his kinsmen are the devotees of Śiva, and the three worlds are his own domain. (15)
Thus ends the *Annapūrṇāstotra* composed by the venerable Śaṅkarācārya.
